domain_reasoning: Documenting the change in the patient record and locating the responsible clinician generally involves operating the EHR, although assessment and reporting also matter.
length_reasoning: A straightforward change can be charted and reported quickly, while a complex deterioration requires more assessment and communication.
review_reasoning: A colleague checks the note and notification against the clinical context, with more records to examine for complex changes.
stakes_reasoning: An omitted or inaccurate report can delay treatment and cause serious patient harm.
context_reasoning: The nurse needs the facility's charting and escalation processes and familiarity with the patient's care.
match_reasoning: HealthAdminBench uses healthcare records and requires accurate documentation, but its tasks concern revenue-cycle administration rather than clinical deterioration. SOPBench shares policy-guided healthcare workflows but does not focus on nursing assessment and reporting.
best_difference: Revenue-cycle records and payer workflows replace clinical assessment and escalation.

domain_reasoning: The teacher mainly selects or writes instructional questions and directions for students.

review_reasoning: A colleague checks whether the instructions and questions fit the lesson, spending longer on a substantial new assignment.

best_difference: The benchmark covers professional deliverables generally rather than specifically lesson assignments.

domain_reasoning: The deliverable is an advisory, though physical equipment inspection and electrical measurements may take most of the work and are not captured by the domain choices.

review_reasoning: A competent electrician reviews the evidence and advice, with substantial rechecking for a complicated installation.

match_reasoning: JobBench includes occupation-linked professional analysis, but its described tasks do not include inspecting live electrical equipment. None of the other benchmarks closely reproduces a physical electrical hazard assessment and management advisory.
best_difference: The benchmark uses provided files rather than on-site electrical inspection and measurements.

domain_reasoning: The worker usually enters quantities and supply details into a requisition form or purchasing application.
length_reasoning: A routine replacement order is quick, while checking several supplies and approved product choices takes longer.
review_reasoning: The reviewer checks quantities, products and authorization against stock and purchasing rules.
stakes_reasoning: An incorrect request usually causes a reversible shortage, surplus or purchasing correction.
context_reasoning: The worker needs local stock locations, approved products and requisition procedures.
match_reasoning: WorkArena includes ordering items from a service catalog, which shares entering and submitting a supply request but not checking cleaning stock. UI-CUBE similarly covers business-system record entry rather than janitorial inventory assessment.

domain_reasoning: The audit involves examining and reconciling payroll records and calculations in accounting systems and spreadsheets before issuing a report.
length_reasoning: A small straightforward employer audit can take several hours, while a complex multi-period audit can require several days of active work.
review_reasoning: A reviewer examines the report, audit scope, calculations and supporting samples, with more testing for larger audits.
stakes_reasoning: Errors can lead to incorrect premiums, uninsured exposures, tax liabilities or regulatory penalties.
context_reasoning: The audit requires understanding the employer's payroll practices, classifications and records alongside applicable rules.
match_reasoning: APEX-Accounting shares examination and reconciliation of accounting records, but its month-end tasks are not payroll premium and compliance audits. JobBench similarly covers professional analysis from records but does not specifically describe this audit.

domain_reasoning: The translator mainly reviews the material and exchanges written scope, fee and terms with the client.
length_reasoning: A short standard document can be scoped quickly, while specialized material and negotiated terms require more discussion.
review_reasoning: A reviewer checks the source material, scope, pricing basis and agreed terms for consistency.
stakes_reasoning: A scope or pricing mistake can cause client disputes, rework or a financial loss.
context_reasoning: The work depends on language-pair rates and the client's requirements rather than deep employer-specific knowledge.
match_reasoning: CRMArena-Pro includes assessing quotes against policy and handling gradually revealed requests, but not scoping translation work and negotiating its terms. TheAgentCompany includes coordinating requests and pricing through messages and spreadsheets, though its examples are internal company workflows.

domain_reasoning: The worker measures and marks page elements using layout software.
length_reasoning: A simple page with few elements takes minutes, while a dense page with many specifications takes longer.

domain_reasoning: The lawyer reconciles fiduciary transactions and prepares the accounting using financial records, spreadsheets and filing tools.
length_reasoning: A simple account with few transactions takes hours, while a complex estate or trust accounting can take several days.

domain_reasoning: The teacher spends most time reading student answers and writing marks or feedback, then records the results.

review_reasoning: A colleague checks the answer key or rubric and samples graded work and recorded marks, expanding the sample for complex responses.

domain_reasoning: The paralegal mainly drafts and revises legal text from the attorney's facts and instructions.

domain_reasoning: A fiduciary transaction typically requires checking records, executing a transfer or other action in relevant systems, and recording it.

domain_reasoning: The accountant assembles and checks account balances and prepares financial statements in accounting software and spreadsheets.

domain_reasoning: The worker describes the observed problem to the manager, sometimes using a maintenance request system, after noticing it during physical work.

JobBench also uses source-based professional analysis and expert review without specifying legal-authority research.
